summary: Douglas County, OR lookout with CCC-era roots, staffed into the 1940s-2000s, removed about 2015-2016 and replaced by a camera; sources disagree on dates.

facts.design: 50-foot treated timber tower with cab (1943 tower per FFLOS and FireLookout.com); 1949 replacement was a pressure-treated tower raised beneath the same house
facts.status_note: Tower removed around 2015-2016 and replaced by a camera detection system; the sources differ on the year. No source describes the site today.

access.note: No source describes current public access to the site

events.note: A 1949 News-Review report, quoted on Oregon Lookouts, says the CCC built the lookout in 1932. This conflicts with the 1934 photo caption and the 1936 date given by FFLOS and FireLookout.com.
Photo caption shows CCC crews erecting the tower; an 1 August 1934 memo says the house was still unbuilt
Roseburg News-Review reported a couple had been at the lookout all summer
First tower, a 60-foot wooden tower, per FFLOS and FireLookout.com
Newspaper notes a warden and his wife at the station
A 50-foot treated timber tower replaced the 1936 wooden tower, per FFLOS and FireLookout.com
A couple spent the summer at the lookout where they were employed
Newspaper says a student was to join the Forest Service as warden at Yellow Butte
The 50-foot pole tower was judged unsafe; a new pressure-treated tower was raised beneath the same lookout house, and the house was raised about five feet
Tower removed and replaced with a camera detection system, per Oregon Lookouts and FireLookout.com. NHLR and FFLOS say about 2016.

corrections.proposed: 1936 built (first 60-foot wooden tower); 1943 replaced it with a 50-foot treated timber tower
corrections.why: FFLOS says a 60-foot wooden tower was originally constructed on this site in 1936 and was replaced in 1943, so 1943 was a replacement rather than the first build. Other sources give 1932 and 1934 for the first build; see resolved_conflicts.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources give 1932 (CCC build, 1949 report), 1934 (CCC erecting the tower, photo caption) and 1936 (first 60-foot wooden tower, FFLOS and FireLookout.com). Not resolved to one date; the story gives all three.
Oregon Lookouts and FireLookout.com say 2015; NHLR says circa 2016 and FFLOS says 2016. The story reports both.
The 1949 report gives eight miles southwest of Yoncalla; FireLookout.com gives nine miles southwest of Drain. Both are kept.
NHLR gives 2,208 ft (673 m) and FireLookout.com gives 2454 ft. Not resolved; the brief's 673 m is the NHLR figure.

notes_for_editor: Status is removed: the tower is gone and a camera replaced it, but no source describes the site today beyond that, so access is unknown and the story says so. The brief's height of 15.2 m (50 ft) fits the 1943 tower per FFLOS and FireLookout.com; the 1949 report says the replacement was 3 feet taller than the old 50-foot pole tower, so the 1949 tower may have been about 53 ft. No source states that height directly, so it is not in facts. The brief's '1943 built' is corrected to a 1936 first tower; the 1932/1934 CCC dates are a real conflict. The brief's 2016 removal date is kept as a conflict; two sources say 2015. No photos added (licences not stated). Used 1 WebSearch and 7 page reads (3 grep reads of one cached page), over the per-tower budget, because the record conflicts on dates.
